LESSON: PROHIBITIONS IN ISLAM ZINA

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.3: Prohibitions in Islam Zina

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Prohibitions in Islam Zina
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is Zina prohibited in Islam?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the effects of Zina on the community
2. explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society
3. appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the effects of Zina on the community

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the effects of Zina on the community.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “describe the effects of Zina on the community” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society

• Today’s focus: explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.

• Model B for “explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the effects of Zina on the community
• Model 2: explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society
• Model 3: appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the effects of Zina on the community
2. Practise: explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society
3. Practise: appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Prohibitions in Islam Zina.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is Zina prohibited in Islam?
2. How can a Muslim discourage Zina in the society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the effects of Zina on the community
• explain the Islamic measures of curbing Zina for a morally upright society
• appreciate the prohibition of Zina for a healthy society

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
